nodes.description: Owned constructor; assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing deployer-controlled ownership.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner (two-step ownership transfer).
Accepts ownership when msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred and clears newOwner.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner; access control gate for privileged functions.
Token constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, computes fixed supply by multiplication, credits owner balance and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using SafeMath.sub.
Returns balances[tokenOwner] for a queried account.
Debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to] using SafeMath, then emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval; no double-spend guard (ERC20 standard).
Debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits balances[to], emits Transfer.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender] remaining allowance.
Approves spender then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval with msg.sender and data (callback into untrusted contract).
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts; rejects plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function performing an external call to an arbitrary ERC20 contract to sweep tokens to owner.
Address of the current contract owner; controls onlyOwner-gated operations.
Pending owner set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Fixed token supply set in the constructor.
mapping(address => uint) of account token balances.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances.
Token decimals (18) used in supply scaling.
Token symbol string (BIC).
Token name string (beauty industry coin).
msg.sender read in the Owned constructor to initialize owner.
msg.sender used inside the onlyOwner modifier require check.
msg.sender compared against newOwner in acceptOwnership.
msg.sender indexes balances in transfer (debit source).
msg.sender indexes allowed in approve (allowance owner).
msg.sender indexes allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom (spender).
msg.sender used in approveAndCall and forwarded as the from argument to the external receiveApproval callback.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an arbitrary caller-supplied contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary token contract, guarded only by onlyOwner.
Unchecked multiplication 300000000 * 10**uint(decimals) in the constructor, performed without SafeMath.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership; candidate new owner address.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf; address whose balance is queried.
Parameter to of transfer; recipient address.
Parameter tokens of transfer; amount to move.
Parameter spender of approve; allowance beneficiary.
Parameter tokens of approve; allowance amount.
Parameter from of transferFrom; source account debited.
Parameter to of transferFrom; destination account credited.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom; amount moved from allowance/balance.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance; owner of the allowance.
Parameter spender of allowance; spender whose allowance is queried.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall; also the target contract of the external callback.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall; allowance amount also forwarded to callback.
Parameter data of approveAndCall; arbitrary bytes forwarded to the external callback.
Parameter tokenAddress of transferAnyERC20Token; arbitrary external contract address called.
Parameter tokens of transferAnyERC20Token; amount forwarded to the external transfer.
Named return variable balance in balanceOf.
Named return variable remaining in allowance.

edges.reason: _newOwner is written into the newOwner state variable by transferOwnership.
_newOwner value is stored in sv_newOwner.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
to receives the credited balance in transfer.
tokens is the debited/credited amount in transfer.
spender keys the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens is stored as the allowance value in approve.
from is the debited account in transferFrom.
to is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens is subtracted from balance and allowance in transferFrom.
tokenOwner keys allowed in allowance.
spender keys allowed in allowance.
spender receives the allowance in approveAndCall.
tokens is stored as allowance and forwarded to the callback.
data is forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback.
tokenAddress is used as the callee of the ERC20 transfer in transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens is the amount passed to the external ERC20 transfer.
Named return variable balance carries balances[tokenOwner] out of balanceOf.
Named return variable remaining carries allowed[tokenOwner][spender] out of allowance.
spender supplied by the caller becomes the target contract of the receiveApproval external call.
Caller-supplied bytes data is forwarded into the external receiveApproval callback.
tokenAddress determines which external contract is invoked by transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens flows into the external ERC20 transfer call.
msg.sender becomes the owner state variable in the Owned constructor.
msg.sender == owner require gate inside the onlyOwner modifier determines execution flow.
onlyOwner reads sv_owner to compare against msg.sender.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before mutating ownership.
acceptOwnership reads sv_newOwner when comparing to msg.sender.
msg.sender determines whose balance is debited in transfer.
msg.sender indexes the balances mapping in transfer.
msg.sender determines the allowance owner entry written in approve.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is debited in transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
msg.sender determines the allowance owner in approveAndCall.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping in approveAndCall.
msg.sender is forwarded as the from argument into the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
Owned constructor writes the deployer address into sv_owner.
approveAndCall transfers execution to the spender contract via receiveApproval after state changes.
receiveApproval is an arbitrary external callback invoked on a caller-supplied contract.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes the external ERC20 transfer, guarded by onlyOwner.
External call into an arbitrary token contract address supplied by the owner.
Constructor computes 300000000 * 10**uint(decimals) without SafeMath, an unchecked arithmetic operation.
onlyOwner modifier guards execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier guards execution of transferAnyERC20Token.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into sv_newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into sv_owner.
acceptOwnership resets sv_newOwner to address(0).
Constructor assigns the fixed supply to sv__totalSupply.
Constructor credits balances[owner] with _totalSupply.
Constructor sets sv_decimals which scales the supply computation.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom debits and credits the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is only meaningful as the input written to sv_newOwner inside transferOwnership; collapse into the function node.
tokenOwner is a read-only lookup key used solely in balanceOf.
to is the recipient argument of transfer and carries no independent semantics.
tokens is the amount argument of transfer, consumed directly by SafeMath add/sub.
spender is the allowance key used only inside approve.
tokens is the allowance value written only inside approve.
from is the debited account used only within transferFrom.
to is the credited account used only within transferFrom.
tokens is the subtracted amount used only within transferFrom.
tokenOwner is a read-only lookup key used solely in allowance.
spender is a read-only lookup key used solely in allowance.
spender is both the allowance key and the external call target inside approveAndCall.
tokens is the allowance amount and callback argument inside approveAndCall.
data is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call, so it belongs to the unsafe operation node.
tokenAddress is the attacker-selectable callee of the external ERC20 transfer call.
tokens is the amount passed into the external ERC20 transfer call.
balance is a named return variable local to balanceOf with no cross-function role.
remaining is a named return variable local to allowance with no cross-function role.
